### 1. What the user says and how the simulator acts

- Opening: "I'd like to cancel my home health with Harborview Home Health - I'm going to do outpatient therapy instead." Phone 2535554362. Target object: her Home Health Care Authorization with Harborview. Timing: now. Action: cancellation. Authorisation: the patient herself (Linda, adult), who confirms.
- Simulator: passive. Gives DOB/DBN/ZIP one at a time when asked. Answers stay/care questions only when asked (Bayview 9/22; ER 9/28, kept overnight to be watched, admitted 9/30; waited a day for the ambulance, back to Bayview 10/3; home 10/5; Harborview from 10/6, last came yesterday; hospital bed delivered 10/6; reconsideration decided in her favour yesterday; second look asked yesterday at Bayview's latest bill). Waits while records are brought up to date. Runs the confirmation tool the agent hands over, with the reference number and units the agent states, and checks any figure that differs.

### 2. Act, wait or refuse at the frozen moment

Act now, through a chain of agent writes followed by the customer's own confirmation. Visible grounds:
- `cancellation_and_expiry`: "A patient may cancel an approved authorization they no longer need, only by their own confirmation". `patient_confirmed_outpatient_cancellation` scope includes "the Home Health Care Authorization"; the tool is "the customer's own tool".
- Record: Harborview HH authorization `98cf7177-...` (WRA-2026-1001-5527) has `status: denied`, `denial_reason: not_medically_necessary`, `units_requested: 36`; the Medical Necessity Reconsideration WAP-26-110457 on it is `decided_overturned` with `decision_date 2026-10-13`, a `letter_of_medical_necessity` received 2026-10-07. So the authorization the customer wants to cancel is not yet approved and has no grant: it cannot be cancelled as it stands.
- No refusal ground: TRICARE Select Retiree Group A active since 2021-01-01; Home Health Care Authorization is required under TRICARE Select (`plan_requirement_matrix`).

### 4. Computations

**4c. Issue of HH auth `98cf...` on overturned reconsideration.** Span (`span_and_units_on_overturned_issue`, `validity_span_and_approved_units`): care already given (Harborview lines from 10/6, the caller "Harborview started coming on October 6") → **valid_from 2026-10-06**, 60 validity days → **valid_through 2026-12-04**. **4d. Root: release on the customer's cancellation of HH auth `98cf...`.** Baseline (`units_released_on_outpatient_cancellation`): 52 granted + 0 − 0 used = 52 (**fall-back 52**).

### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials only

Problems: P-root cancel HH (customer's own write) ← P1 issue overturned HH ← P2 close lapsed SNF ← P3 post facility day use for line 41228.
- Hop root→P1, **state-derived**. `patient_confirmed_outpatient_cancellation`: "The units a cancellation releases are figured only after any reconsideration of the authorization's denial that was decided overturned or partially overturned shows as a grant on an appeal overturn in the authorization's unit history." Query: MNR on `98cf...` decided_overturned; ledger for `98cf...` has no entries; status denied. Search for "grant on the basis of an appeal overturn": `issue_on_overturned_reconsideration` "One grant entry on the basis of an appeal overturn is added to its unit history." Also `cancellation_and_expiry` "cancel an approved authorization".
- Hop P1→P2, **state-derived**. `issue_on_overturned_reconsideration`: "A home health care authorization overturned on reconsideration is not issued until every skilled nursing facility authorization of the patient whose validity span has ended shows as expired or exhausted." Query: SNF `a2be...` span ended 10/5, status approved, units_remaining 9 (not exhausted). Search for the write that makes it "expired": `lapse_of_facility_authorizations` "The authorization's status becomes expired".
- Hop P2→P3, **state-derived**. `lapse_of_facility_authorizations`: "The days a lapsed facility authorization releases are fixed only after every facility claim line billed under the authorization carries its use entry in the unit history." Query: lines with `prior_authorization_id a2be...` = 39880, 40354, 41228; ledger uses exist for 39880/40354 only. Search "use entry": `facility_day_use_entries` "One use entry in the authorization's unit history, tied to the claim number and line number".
- P3 states no prerequisite. Order: P3 → P2 → P1 → root. No hop was pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool, route or chain.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what was asked" (hand over the cancellation now): the HH authorization is `denied`; only an approved authorization may be cancelled, and its release is "figured only after" the overturn shows as a grant. Excluded by the visible rules plus the records.
- Issue the HH authorization without closing the SNF one: excluded by the issue doc's "not issued until ..." and the SNF's approved status past its span. Close the SNF before posting line 41228: excluded by "fixed only after every facility claim line ... carries its use entry".
- Closest alternative numbers: posting 7 (no factor) / 9/26 start; lapse 8; issue 30 (old "lesser of" clause, retired in `validity_span_and_approved_units`) or span from the issue date 10/14 (excluded: care was already given from 10/6); cancellation 52 (no factor), or 30 if holds were taken before the cap (excluded by the cap doc's "as they stand after the units used and the lines counted as used are taken off").
- The open Claim Factual Reconsideration on line 41228 doesn't block the posting under any visible rule. It enters only the lapse hold.
